description: A company's published CRISP™ score and AI visibility reading in each market the AI Authority Index™ measures it in, with the month measured and its Standing Report link. Accepts a company name or slug. Read-only. Every result carries its citation and link.

market.description: Optional market slug, to return one market's Standing Report with all five factors.
